fakemon.description: A cheery rainforest Fakemon, Scorchick's feathers glow with heat. Their sweet natured personalities and strong verbal communication skills help them form close bonds with parents, trainers and other nest mates. Scorchick love spicy peppers, and can be a pest to growers that specialize in these fruits. It's thought that the capsaicin is related to the chemical reaction required to power their flames, which ignite the wings, tail and tuft of the Fakemon without harming the chick itself. Don't be deceived by the cute Fakemon however, the fires ignited are hot enough to melt iron.
fakemon.name: Scorchick

fakemon.description: These rare and graceful Fakemon inhabit the warmest and most heavily planted bodies of water in the rainforest. Sylvafin carry themselves with a sense of dignity and grace - until it is feeding time. In this instance, they become quite the little beggars, forgetting to act the part of an elitist. Their scales reflect sunlight, and perhaps something deeper, causing the Fakemon to glow. It's methods baffle scientists, who have recently discovered that the source of the glow has nothing to do with bioluminescence, as if the source of the glow cannot be explained by the natural world alone. The trusting disposition and rarity of these Fakemon makes conducting any studies extremely unpopular with most people.
fakemon.name: Sylvafin

fakemon.description: A rare and wild wonder, Keklid require extremely precise temperatures, humidity and fungal conditions to germinate from tiny seeds. Such conditions can only exist in the deep lowland rainforests and only under a seed's exposure to a specific fungal host. Upon hatching however, they voraciously seek out fungal colonies to feast on mycelium. It's thought that the fungal networks not only power the flower's own metabolism, but that it also has the unusual effect of granting the Fakemon a type of non-animal cognition as well. These Fakemon are generally described as joyous, but fail to thrive in cooler or drier conditions.
fakemon.name: Keklid

fakemon.description: A lazy forest Fakemon that hangs in the canopy, waking only long enough to eat leaves. Its cushioned, insulated body protects it when it falls, though it would rather eat rotting leaves on the muddy floor than climb back up. Its warm, contented reputation is difficult to verify: official observations question whether Slumboth displays any recognizable personality.
fakemon.name: Slumboth

fakemon.description: Dartlet are most often seen croaking contentedly after heavy rain. Their brilliant colors flash as they hop, warning other creatures of the toxins secreted through their skin. Their beauty and enormous eyes have made them popular with people—usually from a respectful distance. Dartlet are unusually well-tempered and readily approach patient Trainers, to the limited extent that they understand what training is. Even incidental contact with their poison remains hazardous, however. Healthy Dartlet constantly burn excess metabolic energy as heat, and become noticeably warm when excited. Their seemingly impossible metabolism continues to bewilder endocrinologists.
fakemon.name: Dartlet

fakemon.description: Small flying Fakemon commonly found in huge numbers near still bodies of water. Its wings are weak, so it avoids winds stronger than a gentle breeze. When it bites larger Fakemon or people, it leaves behind an itchy bump. Skeeter seems to take particular delight in annoying larger beings and grows noticeably more aggressive after sunset. Its bites are often close together, and people or Fakemon bitten once are more likely to be bitten again. Surely this is only survival pressure and not malice. After all, a bug like this cannot willingly choose evil.
fakemon.name: Skeeter

fakemon.description: The presence of elusive Lochirp indicates a rainforest rich in healthy flowering plants. These tiny nectar-feeders scatter dust that stimulates new buds and sleep inside large flowers wrapped in petal-like plumage. Though widely imagined as gentle moon-blossom spirits, they are active by day and aggressively defend productive flowers, becoming fiercely loyal only to a small circle of trusted companions.
fakemon.name: Lochirp

absolve.description: Releases the user from all special conditions.
absolve.name: Absolve

alkaloid_mist.description: A powerful poison attack with a 30% chance of poisoning a foe. If Harsh Sunlight is active, that chance increases to 60%.
alkaloid_mist.name: Alkaloid Mist

aqua_jet.description: Hits the foe with a blast of water. Has a 30% chance to slow a target.
aqua_jet.name: Aqua Jet

aureal_flood.description: A majestic blast of purified water that deals high damage and removes all status conditions from the user's party.
aureal_flood.name: Aureal Flood

bite.description: A weak physical attack that has a 10% chance to make a foe flinch.
bite.name: Bite

blood_draw.description: Leeching attack that heals the user for 50% of the damage done.
blood_draw.name: Blood Draw

bloodmoon.description: Sets up the Bloodmoon weather for 3 turns. While active, the power of Dark type attacks is increased by 25%. Dark type attacks also heal the user for 10% of the damage dealt. Ghost type attacks have a 20% chance to burn a foe. Lastly, Light, Mystic and Normal type attacks deal -25% damage while Bloodmoon is active.
bloodmoon.name: Bloodmoon

bloom.description: Opens an enormous flower, increasing Special Attack and Special Defense by 1 stage and healing the user for 33% of their maximum health.
bloom.name: Bloom

brilliant_light.description: A corrective blast of light that isn't affected by type resistance.
brilliant_light.name: Brilliant Light

bulk_up.description: Raises the user's Special Attack and Special Defense by 1 stage.
bulk_up.name: Bulk Up

burn_off.description: Burns away all special conditions from the user.
burn_off.name: Burn Off

buzz.description: A weak bug attack that lowers a foe's Special Defense by 1 stage.
buzz.name: Buzz

cacophony.description: Stirs up a bombardment of mental noise, reducing a foe's Special Defense by 3 stages.
cacophony.name: Cacophony

celestial_chorus.description: Sets up the Celesital Chorus weather for 3 turns. While active, the power of Light type attacks is increased by 50%. Prayer heals 50% more damage, and Dark and Ghost type attacks also deal -50% damage while Celestial Chorus is active.
celestial_chorus.name: Celestial Chorus

challenging_call.description: Calls the foe to a challenge, lowering their attack by 1 stage, and adds a 80% chance for them to despair. If the foe is a Dragon type, it will always dispair.
challenging_call.name: Challenging Call

chlorophyll_cannon.description: Fires off a superheated ball of chlorophyll, dealing heavy damage. Has a 20% chance to burn a foe.
chlorophyll_cannon.name: Chlorophyll Cannon

cinder_flick.description: A weak fire attack that has a 30% chance to burn a foe.
cinder_flick.name: Cinder Flick

cleanse.description: Washes away all special conditions from the user.
cleanse.name: Cleanse

coat_toxin.description: Sprays poisonous gunk at a foe, dealing high damage. Has a 20% chance to poison a foe.
coat_toxin.name: Coat Toxin

constrict.description: Plant attack that has a 20% chance to paralyze a foe.
constrict.name: Constrict

counter.description: Retaliates a physical attack, dealing twice the damage the user sustained.
counter.name: Counter

croak.description: Lets out a Croak, reducing a foe's Special Defense by 1 stage. If the egg group of a foe is an Amphibian, it also applies a stack of infatuation.
croak.name: Croak

dartlet_stare.description: Fixes the foe with an intense stare, lowering their Special Defense by 1 stage.
dartlet_stare.name: Stare

dazzle.description: A weak Mystic attack that needs a turn to recharge. Flinches a foe, and reduces their Special Defense by 1 stage.
dazzle.name: Dazzle

defense_curl.description: Tightens the body, increasing the user's Defense by 1 stage.
defense_curl.name: Defense Curl

disable.description: Prevents the foe's last used move for 4 turns.
disable.name: Disable

discern.description: Correctly judges a situation, increasing the user's Special Defense by 3 stages.
discern.name: Discern

doze_off.description: Heals one third of the user's maximum HP, then puts the user to sleep.
doze_off.name: Doze Off

drain.description: A weak plant attack that heals half of the damage dealt.
drain.name: Drain

drain_toxin.description: A weak plant attack that heals the user 15% of it's maximum HP. Any Poison weakness the user may have is removed for 3 turns after use.
drain_toxin.name: Drain Toxin

dream.description: Uses another move at random. Can only be used when the user is sleeping.
dream.name: Dream

evade.description: Becomes immune to an attack this turn, but becomes less effective the more it is used.
evade.name: Evade

fey_dust.description: Scatters mystical dust on a foe, adding a stack of infatuation, and reducing their Special Defense by 2 stages.
fey_dust.name: Fey Dust

fey_gardens.description: Creates Fey Gardens weather for 3 turns. Mystic attacks deal 25% more damage; Plant and Mystic Fakemon gain 10% more maximum HP from healing moves, cannot have their Special Attack or Special Defense lowered, and gain an extra infatuation stack the first time they infatuate a foe.
fey_gardens.name: Fey Gardens

fin_flash.description: Strikes the foe with a flash of water. Its power increases from 40 to 60 if the user's Special Defense is raised.
fin_flash.name: Fin Flash

fire_charge.description: A fiery physical charge with a 10% chance to burn the foe. The user loses 25% of their current HP as recoil.
fire_charge.name: Fire Charge

fireheart.description: Kindles the user's inner flame, preventing them from fainting for 2 turns. This move has a 1-turn reuse delay.
fireheart.name: Fireheart

flamethrower.description: Scorches the foe with an intense stream of flame. Has a 20% chance to burn the foe.
flamethrower.name: Flamethrower

flashcroak.description: Unleashes a fiery croak that has a 30% chance to confuse the foe.
flashcroak.name: Flashcroak

flip_turn.description: Attacks the foe, then switches the user with a random party member and passes along the user's stat changes.
flip_turn.name: Flip Turn

flutter.description: Flutters gracefully, raising the user's Special Attack and Special Defense by 1 stage.
flutter.name: Flutter

gather.description: Gathers strength to heal one third of the user's maximum HP and grants immunity to Confusion and Flinch on the next turn.
gather.name: Gather

gnaw.description: Gnaws at the foe 2 to 5 times in succession.
gnaw.name: Gnaw

grand_display.description: Stages a grand display, raising the user's Special Attack and Speed by 2 stages. For 2 turns, special attacks against the user poison the attacker.
grand_display.name: Grand Display

gust.description: Blasts the foe with a gust of air. Has a 20% chance to slow the foe.
gust.name: Gust

hammer_arm.description: Strikes the foe with a powerful arm.
hammer_arm.name: Hammer Arm

harsh_sunlight.description: Creates Harsh Sunlight weather for 3 turns. Fire and Plant attacks deal 50% more damage, while Water and Ice attacks deal 50% less damage.
harsh_sunlight.name: Harsh Sunlight

heat_up.description: Builds momentum with a burst of heat, dealing light damage while raising the user's Speed by 3 stages and Special Attack by 1 stage.
heat_up.name: Heat Up

hypnotic_hum.description: Hums a hypnotic tune, lowering the foe's Speed by 1 stage and giving them a 50% chance to fall asleep.
hypnotic_hum.name: Hypnotic Hum

hysteria.description: Assaults the foe in a frenzy. Has a 20% chance to paralyze the foe, increased to 30% during Rootmind.
hysteria.name: Hysteria

ignite.description: Ignites a small flame around the foe. Has a 20% chance to burn the foe.
ignite.name: Ignite

incinerate.description: Engulfs the foe in flame. Has a 20% chance to burn the foe.
incinerate.name: Incinerate

inferno.description: Unleashes a devastating inferno that burns the user's entire party and costs the user 80% of their current HP. Harsh Sunlight remains active.
inferno.name: Inferno

inferno_plume.description: Strikes with an overwhelming plume of fire. Has a 40% chance to burn the foe, but the user must recharge next turn.
inferno_plume.name: Inferno Plume

inner_focus.description: Clears all stat changes from the user and prevents their next move from causing self-damage.
inner_focus.name: Inner Focus

intercept.description: A swift aerial strike that acts with increased priority and has a 5% chance to make the foe flinch.
intercept.name: Intercept

kinetic_pummel.description: Pummels the foe with kinetic force. Has a 20% chance to lower the foe's Defense by 1 stage.
kinetic_pummel.name: Kinetic Pummel

leap.description: Leaps into the foe and grants the user's next move increased priority.
leap.name: Leap

leech_life.description: Drains the foe's vitality, healing the user for 50% of the damage dealt.
leech_life.name: Leech Life

lotus_absolution.description: A purifying light attack that doubles in power against a poisoned foe, then cures their poison. During Harsh Sunlight or Fey Gardens, it also heals one third of the user's maximum HP.
lotus_absolution.name: Lotus Absolution

lotus_dart.description: Launches a sharpened lotus at the foe. Has a 30% chance to poison the foe.
lotus_dart.name: Lotus Dart

magic_pulse.description: Fires a pulse of unstable magic with a 40% chance to randomly burn, poison, paralyze, condemn, despair, infatuate, slow, or confuse the foe.
magic_pulse.name: Magic Pulse

mimic.description: Copies and uses the foe's last move.
mimic.name: Mimic

mind_bolt.description: Strikes with psychic force and has a 20% chance to make the foe flinch or become confused. The chance increases to 30% during Rootmind.
mind_bolt.name: Mind Bolt

mind_wave.description: Washes over the foe with psychic energy. Has a 20% chance to confuse the foe, increased to 30% during Rootmind.
mind_wave.name: Mind Wave

mist.description: Envelops the field in mist, clearing all stat changes from the user and foe.
mist.name: Mist

mycelial_hunt.description: Hunts the foe through a mycelial network, increasing in power from 75 to 90 if the foe has a condition. During Rootmind, its power is 90, or 120 against a foe with a condition.
mycelial_hunt.name: Mycelial Hunt

mystic_stream.description: Channels a stream of mystic energy. Its power increases by 10% for each positive Speed stage the user has.
mystic_stream.name: Mystic Stream

nectar_drink.description: Drinks restorative nectar, healing 10% of the user's maximum HP and curing one condition.
nectar_drink.name: Nectar Drink

needle_nip.description: Nips the foe with a draining needle, healing the user for 50% of the damage dealt.
needle_nip.name: Needle Nip

nest.description: Restores 15% of the user's maximum HP. If the user is an Air type, it instead restores 33% and removes their Air typing for 2 turns.
nest.name: Nest

night_dart.description: A swift dark strike with increased priority. Its power doubles if the foe is asleep or confused.
night_dart.name: Night Dart

paradise_bloom.description: Clears all of the user's stat changes and removable conditions, then heals 15% of their maximum HP plus 10% for each stat stage cleared and 20% for each condition cleared.
paradise_bloom.name: Paradise Bloom

paradise_ray.description: Fires an immense ray that clears the weather and removes all conditions from both battlers after dealing damage. The user must recharge next turn.
paradise_ray.name: Paradise Ray

peck.description: Pecks the foe with a sharp beak.
peck.name: Peck

petal_whip.description: Strikes the foe with a whipping petal. Has a 20% chance to poison the foe; during Rootmind, its power rises from 40 to 45 and the chance becomes 30%.
petal_whip.name: Petal Whip

petalwake.description: Surges through the foe in a wake of petals, raising the user's Speed by 1 stage.
petalwake.name: Petalwake

phoenix_charge.description: A blazing charge with a 20% chance to burn the foe. The user loses 25% of their current HP as recoil but cannot faint for 2 turns. This move has a 1-turn reuse delay.
phoenix_charge.name: Phoenix Charge

photon_beam.description: Fires a concentrated beam of light at the foe.
photon_beam.name: Photon Beam

plague.description: Afflicts the foe with a virulent attack that always poisons them.
plague.name: Plague

poison_bubble.description: Blasts the foe with a toxic bubble. Has a 20% chance to poison the foe.
poison_bubble.name: Poison Bubble

poison_tongue.description: Lashes the foe with a poisonous tongue. Has a 30% chance to poison the foe.
poison_tongue.name: Poison Tongue

pounce.description: Pounces on the foe with a physical attack.
pounce.name: Pounce

prayer.description: Offers a prayer that heals the user for 33% of their maximum HP at the start of the next turn.
prayer.name: Prayer

puff_up.description: Puffs up menacingly, raising the user's Special Attack and Defense by 2 stages but lowering their Special Defense by 2 stages.
puff_up.name: Puff Up

punch.description: Strikes the foe with a punch.
punch.name: Punch

purify.description: Purifies the user of all special conditions.
purify.name: Cleanse

quick_bump.description: Quickly bumps into the foe. Has a 30% chance to make the foe flinch.
quick_bump.name: Quick Bump

regrow.description: Clears all of the user's stat changes and removable conditions, healing 10% of maximum HP for each effect cleared. During Rootmind, it heals 12.5% per effect instead.
regrow.name: Regrow

remedy.description: Uses restorative growth to remove all special conditions.
remedy.name: Remedy

remembrance.description: Recalls and uses another eligible move from the user's learnset that they do not currently know.
remembrance.name: Remembrance

rest.description: Heals 50% of the user's maximum HP and cures all conditions, then puts the user to sleep.
rest.name: Rest

restore.description: Removes all special conditions from the user.
restore.name: Restore

rootmind.description: Creates Rootmind weather for 3 turns. Plant Fakemon heal 6.25% of their maximum HP at the end of each turn, and certain moves gain additional effects.
rootmind.name: Rootmind

scald.description: Blasts the foe with scalding water. Has a 20% chance to burn the foe.
scald.name: Scald

scourge.description: Savages the foe with a brutal attack, but cannot make the target faint.
scourge.name: Scourge

scratch.description: Scratches the foe with sharp claws.
scratch.name: Scratch

seed.description: Plants a restorative seed on the target. Starting after 1 turn, it heals 15% of the target's maximum HP at the end of each turn for 3 turns.
seed.name: Seed

shadow_snap.description: Snaps at the foe with a dark physical attack.
shadow_snap.name: Shadow Snap

skyfall.description: Drops onto the foe from above, using the foe's Defense in place of the user's Attack when calculating damage.
skyfall.name: Skyfall

slash.description: Slashes the foe with a sharp attack.
slash.name: Slash

sleep_off.description: Cures all of the user's conditions, then puts the user to sleep.
sleep_off.name: Sleep Off

sleep_swing.description: A wild sleeping attack that can only be used while asleep. Has a 20% chance to lower the foe's Defense by 1 stage.
sleep_swing.name: Sleep Swing

sleep_talk.description: Attacks through sleep with a weak burst of energy. Can only be used while the user is asleep.
sleep_talk.name: Sleep Talk

smite.description: Smites the foe with radiant power. Has a 20% chance to condemn the foe.
smite.name: Smite

snore.description: A noisy attack that can only be used while asleep. Has a 20% chance to make the foe flinch.
snore.name: Snore

soak.description: Soaks the foe with chilling water. Has a 15% chance to freeze the foe.
soak.name: Soak

solar_ray.description: Focuses sunlight into a powerful ray. Has a 20% chance to burn the foe.
solar_ray.name: Solar Ray

squawk.description: Startles the foe with a piercing squawk, lowering their Defense by 1 stage.
squawk.name: Squawk

stare.description: Fixes the foe with a psychic stare, lowering their Defense by 1 stage.
stare.name: Stare

sun_chorus.description: Sings a scorching chorus that lowers the foe's Special Defense by 3 stages. During Harsh Sunlight, it also infatuates the foe.
sun_chorus.name: Sun Chorus

swarm.description: Gathers a swarm around the user, doubling the power of their next Bug-type attack.
swarm.name: Swarm

swoop.description: Swoops down on the foe with increased priority.
swoop.name: Swoop

synaptic_bloom.description: Triggers a bloom of psychic energy, increasing in power from 80 to 100 if the user has any stat change. During Rootmind, its power is 90, or 110 if the user has a stat change.
synaptic_bloom.name: Synaptic Bloom

torment.description: Torments the foe, preventing them from using the same move twice in a row.
torment.name: Torment

toxic_flare.description: Ignites a toxic flare. Its power is increased by 50% against a poisoned foe, whose poison is then replaced with a burn.
toxic_flare.name: Toxic Flare

veil.description: Raises a ghostly veil that protects the user from attacks this turn. Repeated use is less likely to succeed.
veil.name: Veil

vicegrip.description: Crushes the foe in a powerful grip and prevents them from voluntarily switching out for 2 turns.
vicegrip.name: Vicegrip

vital_cognition.description: Heals 25% of the user's maximum HP. If the user has a condition, it cures all removable conditions; otherwise, it raises Special Attack by 2 stages. During Rootmind, the healing increases to one third of maximum HP.
vital_cognition.name: Vital Cognition

warning_flare.description: Displays a toxic warning, raising the user's Special Attack and Speed by 1 stage. For 2 turns, physical attacks against the user poison the attacker.
warning_flare.name: Warning Flare

whirlwind.description: Whips up a whirlwind that forces the foe to switch with a random party member.
whirlwind.name: Whirlwind

wingbeat.description: Batters the foe with powerful wings. Has a 20% chance to lower the foe's Defense by 1 stage.
wingbeat.name: Wingbeat
